prompt: Go to school at the end of the street.
explanation: For very short distances, walking is fast, healthy and uses no energy at all!

prompt: Visit grandparents who live in the next neighborhood.
explanation: For a short distance within the city, a bike is a great choice: fast and no pollution.

prompt: Go to another city in the country for vacation.
explanation: To travel between cities, the train is comfortable and fast, and you couldn't walk or bike that far.

prompt: Go to another continent to visit a new country.
explanation: To cross oceans and continents quickly, the airplane is the right transport.

prompt: Send a container full of toys to another continent.
explanation: To carry very heavy cargo across the ocean, ships are used most — slower, but they carry much more and use less energy per item.

prompt: Go to the park at the end of the street.
explanation: For somewhere so close, walking is the simplest and healthiest way to get there.

prompt: Go to the bakery to buy fresh bread in the morning.
explanation: The bakery is right there; walking is quick and you get some fresh morning air too.

prompt: Cross a narrow stretch of sea to reach an island near the coast.
explanation: To cross water to a nearby island, a ship (or ferry) is the right choice — there's no road or track over the sea.

prompt: Go to work every day on the other side of the city.
explanation: For a long distance across the city, every day, a car is more practical than walking or biking.

prompt: Go study for a year in a country across the ocean.
explanation: To travel quickly over a very long distance, crossing the ocean, the plane is the right choice.

prompt: Send hundreds of new cars from a factory to be sold on another continent.
explanation: To carry very heavy and bulky cargo across the ocean, ships are used most — they carry much more at once.

prompt: Send urgent medicine to a hospital on the other side of the world.
explanation: When speed matters more than cost, like in an emergency, a plane arrives much faster than a ship.

prompt: Go camping with the family in a forest a few hours from home.
explanation: With so much gear — tent, sleeping bags, food — a car is the most practical choice for a trip this size.
